Court & culture

RALLYA is a movement club built around padel. We care as much about the hour after the match as the match itself — courts, coaching, recovery, and a room full of people worth playing with.

Book a courtBook a lesson

Who we are

More than a court

RALLYA started from one observation: the people who keep moving keep growing. Padel is the doorway — fast, social, a little addictive — but the habit we are really building is momentum. Show up, play hard, recover well, repeat.

So we designed clubs that flex around a week instead of a timetable. A quick match at lunch, a coached session after work, a slow coffee in the lounge — the energy is yours to spend, whenever it suits you.

Good to know

Is padel hard to pick up?

Most people are rallying within their first session — book a starter clinic and a coach will walk you through it.

Do you rent gear?

Rackets and balls are on the house at reception, or bring your own kit.

Can I come without a partner?

Yes — join an open session or ask us to pair you up by level.

How do cancellations work?

Free cancellation up to four hours before your slot, straight from your account.
